observations.behavior: Replaces a simple message sanitization with a credential-aware redaction and a dedicated credential-header detection, while retaining the original truncation and redaction behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent credential leakage in Hog function execution logs and error messages, including those returned from external API responses. The implementation checks for credential-like header names and redacts bearer tokens, while also redacting values explicitly marked as sensitive in Hog function input schemas.
